ability.name: Determine Local Network Range
ability.description: Discovers the local network configuration and routing table to identify the primary subnet.

stages.command_template: if not exist C:\Windows\Temp\bas mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\bas && ipconfig /all > C:\Windows\Temp\bas\ipconfig.txt && route print -4 >> C:\Windows\Temp\bas\ipconfig.txt

rationale: Determines the local network range and gateway configuration to establish the target subnet for scanning.
